cast: Elizabeth II of the United Kingdom
c90a46e3b0f2d9fde3291c57d8692e17.overview: Elizabeth is an archive-based documentary film about the Queen. A celebration. A truly cinematic mystery-tour up and down the decades: poetic, funny, disobedient, ungovernable, affectionate, inappropriate, mischievous, in awe. Funny. Moving. Different. The Queen as never before.

c93c13c05fd6529036e09247ce4df2df.overview: After a bank robbery, runaway Scottish outlaw Arch Deans and his young half-breed Kiowa partner Billy Two Hats develop a father-son relationship, but Sheriff Henry Gifford is determined to capture or kill them.
c93c13c05fd6529036e09247ce4df2df.tagline: Against the Law...Against the Odds...Against the Land Itself

c93ccf20e5b6ea54464b57955fa7854e.overview: A man decides to cook for himself and finds a revolver (which may have belonged to John Dillinger) hidden in his kitchen.

c94d7911d46ff9abe41f64e8e674e930.overview: For Norman and Ethel Thayer, this summer on golden pond is filled with conflict and resolution. When their daughter Chelsea arrives, the family is forced to renew the bonds of love and overcome the generational friction that has existed for years.
c94d7911d46ff9abe41f64e8e674e930.tagline: When life is at its finest... when love is at its fullest...

c95ad72a8f370ff956ef6812adfb4747.overview: An educated native of Mauritania tries to find work in Paris but encounters difficulty because of his race.

c95c66e4ec907ff88a1847268c104d71.overview: After the previous Godzilla attack, a miniature arms race ensues to collect his cells. Concerned over Godzilla's possible return, the Japanese government uses the cells to create a new bio-weapon, ANEB (Anti-Nuclear Energy Bacteria). They seeks the aid of geneticist Genshiro Shiragami, who's experiments result in a new mutation.
c95c66e4ec907ff88a1847268c104d71.tagline: The winner of this battle would be the most enormous enemy against human beings.

c9d8bd18901dc89e92af80ff60a8e7cc.overview: A Chinese doctor vows revenge against the allied troops who killed his wife and child during the Boxer Rebellion.
c9d8bd18901dc89e92af80ff60a8e7cc.tagline: DANGER - MYSTERY - THRILLS you'll never forget!

c9da0915b02879745d7cd394db605c3b.overview: A handsome young man trades his soul so that his portrait ages while he stays eternally young.
c9da0915b02879745d7cd394db605c3b.tagline: Why did women talk about Dorian Gray in whispers?

c9deff191ee5953209b00ccdd36351a8.overview: Hildy Johnson is an investigative reporter looking for a bigger paycheck. When an accused murderer escapes from custody, Hildy sees an opportunity for the story of a lifetime. But when he finds the criminal, he learns that the man may not be guilty. With the help of his editor, Hildy attempts to hide the convict, uncover the conspiracy and write the scoop of his career.
c9deff191ee5953209b00ccdd36351a8.tagline: A Picture That Has Cracked This Shock-Proof Town Wide Open!

c9f1c82c5d1737a81a88f5da98e48451.overview: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet with the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After Dracula enslaves and drives the agent to insanity, the pair return to London together, where Dracula, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.
c9f1c82c5d1737a81a88f5da98e48451.tagline: The story of the strangest passion the world has ever known!
